text:
mira: quick heads-up — ran nsys diff between nightly and canary-quant and saw a 2x token-p90 regression for a couple of matmul shapes.
sam: which shapes?
mira: batch=1 seq=2048 hidden=4096 (long chat) and batch=4 seq=512 hidden=4096. both show tail spikes.
joel: any sign of cublasLt algo flip?
mira: yes. perfetto shows repeated alternation between cublasLtMatmul(algo=5) and cublasLtMatmul(algo=12) across sequential calls. workspace requests jump from ~0 to ~320MB and back. allocator churn visible.
anika: kv-cache warmup could be changing alignment/prefix lengths so internal matmul dims wobble by a few elements — that can trigger different algo choices.
mira: captured nsys and a short nvprof dump, command used:```bash
nsys profile --trace=cuda,cublas -o trace_canary ./inference --batch=1 --seq=2048
```
sam: can you paste the hot kernel summary?
mira: pasted snippet from nsys summary:```text
cublasLtMatmul.algo=5  avg=1.2ms  ws=0
cublasLtMatmul.algo=12 avg=3.8ms  ws=320MB
cudaMalloc               avg=0.7ms  spikes during warmup
memcpyAsync              visible between host->dev bursts
```
joel: that looks like allocator fragmentation -> occasional huge workspace forces cublasLt to pick algo12 (slower but workspace-heavy). ping-pong behavior explains tail spikes.
anika: our algo-probe heuristic probably allows a fallback when workspace >= threshold, but because workspace request is intermittent, decisions flip mid-run.
mira: timeline also shows many small host allocations at cublasLtGetWorkspace which align with KV cache refills. attaching perfetto link (private).
infra-bot: deploy canary/2040 to perf cluster succeeded :white_check_mark:
sam: quick mitigation ideas: 1) cap workspace size to 64MB and prefer deterministic algo for known shapes 2) preallocate persistent workspace buffer to avoid cudaMalloc churn 3) add alignment-aware probe to avoid shape wobble triggers.
mira: i'll run A/B tomorrow: (a) pin workspace cap; (b) persistent prealloc; (c) microbench sweeping prefix length mod 256 to reproduce alignment effect.
joel: also try forcing algo selection via cublasLt config for those shapes to confirm perf delta.
anika: I'll add a small change to the probe heuristic to require N consecutive probes before switching algo.
mira: created INF-827 to track. I'll attach perfetto slices + nsys diffs and post follow-up.
sam: :thumbsup:
mira: thanks — will report results here.
